A list of identities that are allowed access through this 'EgressPolicy'. Should be in the format of email address. The email address should represent individual user or service account only.
Specifies the type of identities that are allowed access to outside the perimeter. If left unspecified, then members of 'identities' field will be allowed access.
Whether to enforce traffic restrictions based on 'sources' field. If the 'sources' field is non-empty, then this field must be set to 'SOURCE_RESTRICTION_ENABLED'.
An AccessLevel resource name that allows resources outside the ServicePerimeter to be accessed from the inside.
The psc_endpoint block, written as HCL.
A Google Cloud resource that is allowed to egress the perimeter. Requests from these resources are allowed to access data outside the perimeter. Currently only projects are allowed.
A list of external resources that are allowed to be accessed. A request matches if it contains an external resource in this list (Example: s3://bucket/path). Currently '*' is not allowed.
A list of resources, currently only projects in the form 'projects/<projectnumber>', that match this to stanza. A request matches if it contains a resource in this list.
A list of IAM roles that represent the set of operations that the sources specified in the corresponding 'EgressFrom' are allowed to perform.
The method_selectors block(s), written as HCL.

The name of the API whose methods or permissions the 'IngressPolicy' or 'EgressPolicy' want to allow. A single 'ApiOperation' with serviceName field set to '*' will allow all methods AND permissions for all services.
Human readable title. Must be unique within the perimeter. Does not affect behavior.
A list of identities that are allowed access through this ingress policy. Should be in the format of email address. The email address should represent individual user or service account only.
Specifies the type of identities that are allowed access from outside the perimeter. If left unspecified, then members of 'identities' field will be allowed access.
An 'AccessLevel' resource name that allow resources within the 'ServicePerimeters' to be accessed from the internet. 'AccessLevels' listed must be in the same policy as this 'ServicePerimeter'.
The psc_endpoint block, written as HCL.
A Google Cloud resource that is allowed to ingress the perimeter. Requests from these resources will be allowed to access perimeter data. Currently only projects are allowed.

A list of resources, currently only projects in the form 'projects/<projectnumber>', protected by this 'ServicePerimeter' that are allowed to be accessed by sources defined in the corresponding 'IngressFrom'.
A list of IAM roles that represent the set of operations that the sources specified in the corresponding 'IngressFrom' are allowed to perform.

The name of the API whose methods or permissions the 'IngressPolicy' or 'EgressPolicy' want to allow. A single 'ApiOperation' with 'serviceName' field set to '*' will allow all methods AND permissions for all services.
The list of APIs usable within the Service Perimeter. Must be empty unless 'enableRestriction' is True.
Whether to restrict API calls within the Service Perimeter to the list of APIs specified in 'allowedServices'.
